resources.string: Choose where to save your passkey in the system dialog. It can be different from the account you used to sign in. No recovery phrase is required.
The passkey was saved, but its provider did not supply the protection your memories need. Setup is not complete. Repeating verification may not help. Your existing key has not been replaced.
Recovery did not complete. Existing keys were not replaced. Check the connection and recovery method.
Passkey recovery requires Android 9 or newer. This device cannot complete passkey setup.
Access saved and recovery verified. An additional recovery code is optional.
Passkey saved, but verification is not complete yet. Retry to finish verifying the same passkey.
Sign in and restore with a passkey
Optional extra protection. Code recovery also requires signing in to your account. You do not need to save this code to continue.
